title: What does 10% a year do over 50 years?

probes.question: $1 grows 10% a year for 50 years. About how many dollars is that?

image.alt: A wordless curve that starts flat and climbs steeply, with orange coins growing larger along it, drawn in the middle of a cream background.

body.question: If $1 grows by 10% every year for 50 years, about how many dollars does it become?
body.reveal: About $117. Growth that compounds, 1.10 multiplied by itself 50 times, is far bigger than the $6 you'd have if you added 10 cents of the original dollar each year. This is a maths example, not investment advice.
